For a Pune ecommerce shop:

Option	Indicative price	Features	Availability
3-ply corrugated box	₹9–₹25/box	Lightweight, recyclable, good for apparel/general goods	High; many Pune suppliers
5-ply corrugated box	₹25–₹40+/box	Better crush/impact protection; suitable for fragile/heavier items	High, including custom sizes
Self-locking mailer + paper cushioning	~₹5–₹30+ for mailer; cushioning extra	Better unboxing, no plastic, less tape; good for D2C	Moderate–high; custom MOQ often 1,000–3,000

Pune listings show broad corrugated pricing from roughly ₹9–₹40, while 5-ply ecommerce boxes are listed around ₹40. 
Tradeindia
+1

My pick: 3-ply for standard SKUs, 5-ply for fragile products, and mailers for premium/lightweight orders. Check GSM, ECT/burst strength, recycled content, dimensions, MOQ, customization and delivered cost.
